R Code Style Rules (General)

In R/ or analysis/ or code/:

  • Use snake_case for all variables and functions
  • Assign with <-, not =
  • Indent with 2 spaces, no tabs
  • Keep lines under 100 characters
  • Prefer |> over %>% if both are used
  • Avoid unnecessary return(), but okay for clarity
  • Keep functions short and focused
  • Use roxygen2 comments to document exported functions
  • Use tibbles, not data.frames, when working with tabular data
  • Validate inputs early with stop() or warning()
  • Document code to explain WHY - not just WHAT you did
  • Break code into small, discrete pieces.

In tests/:

  • Use testthat 3e with test_that() blocks
  • Name test files as test-<function>.R
  • Use one behavior per test block
  • Follow Arrange–Act–Assert structure
  • Keep tests close to the logic they verify

Package-wide:

  • Use usethis to scaffold new functions and tests
  • Organize functions by topic in R/, not all in one file
  • Declare imports with @importFrom, avoid library() in R scripts
  • Stick to tidyverse style if already used in project
